usage.reason: The source documents no per-user last-active field and no audit or activity log. The user record only has id, name, type and email. Agent insights and session endpoints exist but cover Notion AI agents, not general workspace usage per person.

assumptions: The source lists bearer and basic auth schemes. Basic is not described for server access, so only bearer is listed. Notion normally uses an integration token or OAuth access token.
The Notion-Version header is required, but the source does not give a value. I assumed 2022-06-28. Please confirm the right version, since the source mentions newer features.
The source gives no page size limit. I used 100, which I believe is Notion's maximum but could not confirm from the source.
The user list does not include a status, so suspended or removed members cannot be told apart. Status is left unmapped.
Email is only present for person users, and only if the integration has user-information capability. This is not stated in the source.
The source gives no rate limit, so those fields are left empty.
No per-user last-active field or activity log appears in the source, so usage is marked unavailable.
Only the bot-versus-person distinction is mapped for user type. Guests cannot be identified from the source.
